svg.title: SevaForge v3.0 — Cloud-Deployed Architecture (GCP)
svg.text: LAYER 4 — Pipeline Agents (GKE Pods — HPA Autoscaled)
LAYER 6 — External AI Providers (via Vertex Model Garden)
CLI/API → Cloud LB → Cloud Armor + IAP → GKE Autopilot (MissionControl) → Agent Pods → Vertex AI → AlloyDB/GCS → Response
Pub/Sub async pipeline • AlloyDB pgvector for RAG • Workload Identity (no service account keys) • Cloud Armor WAF + IAP zero-trust
GKE Autopilot auto-provisions nodes • HPA per agent type • Pub/Sub handles backpressure • Memorystore caches LLM responses
